description: Unofficial Copilot-style chat for the OpenCode coding agent: streaming, sessions, diffs and inline permissions, powered by your local `opencode serve`.
container.title: OpenCode
config.executablePath: Path of the `opencode` executable used to start `opencode serve` (one process per workspace folder).
config.endpoint: URL of an already running OpenCode server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). When set, no process is started; use **OpenCode: Set Server Password…** to store its password in the OS keychain.
config.autoContext: Show the active file and selection as context chips. Selections are attached automatically; add the active file to a message with one click.
config.dropzone: Enable drag & drop of files into the chat to attach them to the message. Enabled by default; disable it if drag & drop interferes with VS Code (which normally opens dropped files in an editor unless Shift is held).
config.startupTimeout: Milliseconds to wait for `opencode serve` to become healthy.
config.autoRestart: Restart the managed server automatically if it exits unexpectedly (max 5 times in 2 minutes).
config.sessionPermissions: Permission rules (`action`, `resource`, `effect`) added to new sessions. By default the extension asks before edits, shell commands and access outside the workspace; set `[]` to restore OpenCode's permissive defaults. See https://opencode.ai/docs/permissions/.
config.autoApprovePermissions: Automatically approve every permission request (edits, shell commands, access outside the workspace) without showing the approval panel above the composer. Requests are granted once, so saved rules are untouched. Off by default: enable it only if you trust the agent with unattended changes.
config.sessionPageSize: Number of sessions shown per page in the session list. Use **Load more sessions** to fetch the next page.
config.toolOutputLimit: Characters of a tool's output shown inline before the **output (n)** affordance. Raise it to review long command output without expanding every card.
config.notifyOnComplete: Show a notification when a turn finishes while the chat is hidden, with an action to open it. Off by default to avoid noise on long sessions.
config.notifyOnFailure: Show a notification when a turn fails while the chat is hidden, with an action to open it.
config.promptLibrary: Reusable prompts offered by `/` in the chat. Each entry needs a unique `id`, a `title` and the `text` to insert; `description` is optional. The text may contain `$selection`, `$file`, `$diff` and `$problems`, which are replaced with the current editor context when you pick it. Built-in prompts (explain, tests, bugs, optimize, document, review, problems, commit) are always available.
config.showUsageInStatusBar: Show a status bar item with the current session's estimated context size and cost. The numbers come from OpenCode and appear after the first reply.
command.moveView: Move Chat View… (left/right side bar, panel)
walkthrough.title: Get started with OpenCode
walkthrough.description: Four quick steps to go from a fresh install to your first reply.
walkthrough.trust.title: Trust this workspace
walkthrough.trust.description: OpenCode starts a local server and reads your saved logins. Workspace settings are only honoured in a trusted workspace.
walkthrough.install.title: Install OpenCode v2
walkthrough.install.description: The extension drives the `opencode` CLI. Install it on your PATH, then come back here — the Install action shows the command and can retry the connection for you.
walkthrough.provider.title: Sign in to a model provider
walkthrough.provider.description: OpenCode needs at least one provider configured before it can answer. Sign in from the account menu, or run `opencode auth login` in a terminal.
walkthrough.chat.title: Say hello
walkthrough.chat.description: Open the chat view, type a prompt and press Enter. Use the session picker at the top to switch between conversations.
workspaceTrust.description: Starting the OpenCode server, reading saved logins and using workspace-specific settings requires a trusted workspace.
